authority: The frozen method defines the scientific recipe. This document defines its five public receipts. Source reconstruction, not submitted provenance, supplies the raw coefficients, cleaned-series reference and canonical activity. Accepted final CSV series determine every circular result; no hidden source-canonical p-value, count, significance or sign target is used.

common_rules.completion: All five artifacts are required. run_metadata.status is ok for completed analysis even when connectivity.status is inactive_target. A resource_pilot or failed_precondition is not a completed submission.
common_rules.failure_marker: Any lexists failure_report.json is authoritative failure, including an empty file, directory or dangling symlink; otherwise complete success receipts do not override it.
common_rules.paths: Required artifacts and all output inventory entries must be regular files/directories, without symbolic links, special files or symlink ancestors. Required files must be nonempty. Do not use pickle/object arrays.
common_rules.json: UTF-8 object documents, unique keys, finite numeric values recursively including optional fields. JSON numbers must be real numeric tokens, never Boolean or numeric strings. Counts are exactly integral signed-int64 values. Boolean fields must be actual JSON Boolean values. Only explicitly nullable fields permit null.
common_rules.csv: UTF-8, one unique nonempty header per column, consistent row widths and complete keyed rows. Required numeric cells are finite real numeric text; exactly integral frame tokens such as 1,1.0,1e0 are equivalent and collide as one key. No implicit index column is required.
common_rules.npz: Non-object NumPy arrays, finite real numeric primitives, literal Unicode or UTF-8 byte strings, and non-Boolean exactly integral numeric key axes. Integral floating axes are accepted when exact and within signed-int64. Required shapes remain exact. Harmless optional arrays may use Boolean, real numeric or text dtypes within bounds; no complex/object/structured dtypes.
common_rules.extras: Harmless finite extra JSON fields, CSV columns, NPZ arrays and files are permitted within the published limits; they do not replace any required evidence. No software-version equality or findings keyword gate.
common_rules.ordering: CSV row/column order and NPZ frame/map axis order may change coherently. The raw matrix and map labels must travel with their explicit frame/map keys. Metadata source/map/support lists may reorder by their explicit path/map_id keys. Shift IDs, null_r and exceeds may reorder only as coherent triples. Missing or duplicate keys fail.
common_rules.numeric_comparison: All inequalities use the frozen method tolerances. Shape, identities, source pins, integer counts, Boolean flags and statuses are exact; numeric receipt rounding never changes which primitive governs inference.

raw_map_coefficients.npz.purpose: Source-bound full simultaneous39-map least-squares receipt; not a two-map fit and not ROI weighted means. Rounded raw receipts are not re-cleaned to define acceptance.

map_ids.keys: 0..38 each exactly once, original fourth-axis map IDs

map_labels.binding: Original atlas labels in the map_ids axis order; surrounding source whitespace stripped by the frozen loader rule. Target original map6=R DMN and map32=Cereb.

raw_coefficients.dtype: finite real numeric, computed float64; other serialization precision accepted only within source tolerance

timeseries.csv.purpose: Two complete final cleaned source-close series, the sole accepted downstream circular-inference primitive.

columns.frame_index: Exactly integral non-Boolean numeric text, original0..175 each once
columns.R DMN: Finite final cleaned coefficient of original map6
columns.Cereb: Finite final cleaned coefficient of original map32

timeseries.csv.active_fidelity: Each canonically active column additionally satisfies centered relativeL2 error<=1e-6, no absolute floor, using the frozen common-prescale accurate centering. Canonical inactive reference series is zero; within-tolerance serialization jitter does not reactivate inference.

connectivity.json.purpose: Signed observed correlation plus every nonzero circular offset and exact own-series rank evidence.

required_fields.subject: Literal0010064
required_fields.status: ok if both canonical targets active; otherwise inactive_target
required_fields.r: Finite real[-1,1] for ok; null for inactive_target
required_fields.p_value: Finite real[0,1] for ok, equal own (1+n_exceedances)/176 within1e-6; null for inactive_target
required_fields.significant: Boolean for ok, exact20*(1+n_exceedances)<176; null for inactive_target

inference.shifts: List of175 exactly integral JSON numeric IDs1..175 each once; no deduplication of periodic surrogate vectors
inference.null_r: List of175 finite real[-1,1] values paired with shifts for ok;175 null entries for inactive_target
inference.exceeds: List of175 Boolean values paired with shifts for ok, each abs(ownunroundedDot_k)>=abs(ownunroundedDot_0);175 null entries for inactive_target
inference.n_exceedances: Integer0..175, exact sum(exceeds), or null for inactive_target
inference.numerator: Integer1..176, exact1+n_exceedances, or null for inactive_target
inference.p_value: Same own rank fraction as top-level alias within1e-6, or null
inference.significant: Same exact own integer-threshold verdict as top-level alias, or null
inference.inactive_regions: List of canonical inactive target labels in fixed R DMN,Cereb target order; empty for ok
inference.status: Same exact categorical status as top level

connectivity.json.replay: Scale-center accepted CSV vectors once; retain all positive roll(x,k) against unchanged y, k1..175, common norms, accurately summed dots, no tie epsilon. Rank is recomputed before correlation serialization. Coherent source-close near-tie perturbations may change count,p,significant; these changes are accepted only with complete own-series recomputation.
connectivity.json.domains: Saved r/null_r remain within[-1,1] and p within[0,1] even when close by tolerance. No NaN/Inf sentinels. Six-decimal scalar/null_r rounding is permitted if within tolerance; rounded receipts never determine exceedances or significant.

run_metadata.json.purpose: Source, public contract, header, nuisance and numerical-support receipts; actual implementation identifiers are descriptive, not reference-version targets.

required_fields.method_sha256: SHA256 of exact public method_contract.json bytes
required_fields.output_schema_sha256: SHA256 of exact public output_schema.json bytes, not a self-hash stored inside that schema
required_fields.source_files: Closed10-record list keyed path, with required path/role/participant_id(nullable)/size_bytes(integer)/sha256 exactly from the pinned manifest; reordered records allowed

source_observed.bold_header: Required header record defined below, source-bound
source_observed.atlas_header: Required header record defined below, source-bound
source_observed.selected_confound_columns: Original source ordered13 names in method.temporal_cleaning.confound_columns
source_observed.map_labels: Closed39-record list keyed integer map_id0..38; each record has map_id and exact map_label
source_observed.target_map_ids: Ordered JSON numeric integer list[6,32] corresponding to R DMN,Cereb
source_observed.operational_TR_s: Numeric2 seconds; does not override the separately preserved original clock

analysis_observed.map_rank: Exact source-derived integer0..39; no minimum-rank outcome gate
analysis_observed.confound_rank: Exact source-derived integer0..13 using frozen QR recipe
analysis_observed.target_support: Closed2-record list keyed map_id6 and32; map_label exact, raw_sample_sd/residual_centered_l2/activity_threshold finite nonnegative reals, active actual Boolean exact canonical source support

required_fields.software_versions: Nonempty object with required python,numpy,scipy,nibabel,nilearn keys and nonempty actual version strings; not_used allowed for genuinely unused library; no equality to reference versions
required_fields.warnings: List of strings, may be empty; no warning text or absence gate

header_record.shape: Ordered exact positive-integer dimensions: BOLD[61,73,61,176], atlas[40,48,35,39]
header_record.selected_affine: Finite real4x4 selected source voxel-to-world affine
header_record.storage_dtype: Semantic NumPy dtype equality, allowing equivalent aliases but preserving kind/itemsize/byte order
header_record.spatial_units: Exact original header unit label, including unknown when original is unspecified
header_record.temporal_units: Exact original header unit label; no invented atlas clock
header_record.zooms: Original ordered four header zoom values
header_record.raw_toffset: Original header temporal offset, separate from operational origin
header_record.raw_scl_slope: Original header scalar, not replaced by effective scaling
header_record.raw_scl_inter: Original header scalar, not replaced by effective scaling

run_metadata.json.header_nonfinite_representation: Only original nonfinite raw header scalars/zooms use exact strings NaN,+Inf,-Inf as applicable. Numeric arrays and all other required numeric receipts remain finite. Raw header strings are not inferred from loaded effective calibration.
run_metadata.json.support_authority: Tolerance on support diagnostics does not redefine eligibility. Rank and activity are source-canonical exact; inactive targets remain present with null paired inference.

findings.md.claim_boundary: Describe the single-recording joint-map coefficient/circular-phase method control honestly. No mandatory numerical effect, p direction, significance reversal, paper claim or wording is graded. Exhaustive shifts remove Monte Carlo uncertainty, not guarantee calibrated type-I error or causal/neural coupling.

authoring_only_pilot: The supplied --pilot-extraction-only route still emits five files with full raw/final primitives and metadata.status=resource_pilot, connectivity.status=resource_pilot, r/p/significant=null,inference=null and explicit resource_pilot_scope. This is not a production positive and does not bypass completed-analysis rules.
no_new_algorithm: All scientific arithmetic, support rules and tolerances are those of the frozen method; this schema introduces no alternate estimator, hidden numerical target or expected outcome.
